latest_release.name: 1.3.1  [Bugfix] - Node 6 compatibility
latest_release.body:
### Things we fixed

- The new template tests we introduced in 1.3.0 used the object rest spread operator, which is only available in node >=8. Since the template should work with node >=6, we fixed this and switched to a node6 docker image on circeci to ensure this won't happen again. (8ce0da4945785873455c6c17cf01c9121a808360 & e1ba1ea34fdd481508ef9289eeb85ecdcacfaca4, closing #1245)
